description: ANFR - Implantation des antennes de téléphonies mobiles is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Location of mobile telephony relay antennas and the location and values of electromagnetic field measurements (EMFs) carried out This website managed by ANFR makes it possible to locate all mobile telephony relays, the operators present there, the types of frequencies issued, the draft modifications in progress, the EMF measurements carried out nearby. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "ANFR – Implantation of mobile telephony antennas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Its keywords include antennes-relais, champs-electromagnetiques, anfr, environnement, telephonie-mobile. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV, SHP. The listing shows 2026-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
